disposition: Far past the P0 hypothesis: collection and database-default policies validate V1 field shapes, the revisions bin lists deleted documents past the age and its cleaner purges eligible entries atomically while refusing live documents, minimum-age floors and per-update caps hold, and purge-on-delete is configurable; conflict-revision configuration (GAP-F07 note in src/families/revisions.rs) and start-from-etag semantics remain absent.
